spans.s: . Salt or barren, (soil.) E. See इरिण.

इरम्मद m. (-दः)
 1. A flash of lightning, or the fire attending the fall of
a thunderbolt.
 2. Submarine fire.
 E. इरा water, here also watery
clouds, and मद what plays or shines.

. The goddess of
speech, &c.
 5. Ardent spirits.
 E. इण् to go, and रन् Unādi affix, fem.
affix टाप्.

ईर r. 2nd cl. (ईर्त्ते)
 1. To go.
 2. To shake. r. 1st and 10th cls. (ईरति,
ईरयति)
 1. To go.
 2. To throw or direct, to drive or force on; with
उत् prefixed, to say or speak; with प्र, to send, to make to go;
with सम्, to go like the wind.

इराचर m. (-रः) Hail.
 mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
 1. Earth-born, terrestrial.
 2.
Aquatic.
 E. इरा water, &c. and चर what goes.

इराज m. (-जः) A name of KANDARPA the Hindu CUPID.
 E. इरा water,
and ज born.

इरावत् m. (-वान्)
 1. The ocean.
 2. A cloud.
 3. A king.
 mfn. (-वान्-वती-
वत्) Watery, having or yielding water, &c.
 E. इरा and मतुप् aff.
इरावेल्लिका f. (-का) Pimples or pustules on the head.
